name: datax-industry
description: Three-level industry taxonomy (industry -> category -> subcategory) for document classification, covering healthcare, finance and government. Every leaf subcategory carries a crosswalk to the `document_type` strings observed in nvidia/Nemotron-PII, so a document labelled here can be lined up against that dataset.

compatibility.derivation: The Healthcare, Finance and Government domains of Nemotron-PII contain 53, 53 and 71 distinct `document_type` values respectively (176 distinct across the three). Those free-text strings were normalised and de-duplicated into the closed leaf vocabulary below; `nemotron_document_types` records the crosswalk for each leaf.
compatibility.note: Nemotron-PII's own `document_type` field is free text (1451 distinct values across 30 domains), not a closed vocabulary. This taxonomy closes it for the three target industries so that leaf labels are enumerable and gradeable.
